content: Table stakes for personal crypto portfolio tracker: (1) Transaction entry (buy/sell: date, coin, qty, price/amount, fees, source). (2) Holdings/position view per coin (qty, total cost, avg unit cost). (3) Correct average cost calculation including fees. (4) Current price lookup via API showing market value and unrealized P&L. (5) Transaction history list with edit/delete. (6) Multi-exchange/wallet consolidation (who I bought from). Leading platforms (Koinly, CoinTracker, CoinStats, CoinTracking) all require these.
